svg.title: Aether: local agents, lasting work
svg.desc: Illustrated overview of the local aetherd daemon, which owns agents, tasks and state. Messages, timers, recurring schedules, signed webhooks and authorized GitHub requests trigger work. Native Claude Code and Codex keep their own loops and tools; Aether also runs an API loop for hosted Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI (Grok), Google (Gemini), Groq and OpenRouter APIs with keys; local Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and llama.cpp servers; and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Grok and Gemini consumer subscriptions are not supported sign-in routes. Tasks, conversations, memory, artifacts, run history, schedules and approvals persist, with recovery support. Built-in tools, MCP servers, shell and Python, TypeScript and Rust clients connect your work. Four mascot scenes show one agent, mixed providers and models in one run, delegation trees with model and effort per agent and optional separate Git worktrees, and event-driven work.
